content.title: OXM Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures and Tariff Mitigation Shape Results
content.summary: Fashion conglomerate Oxford Industries (NYSE:OXM) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales falling 4% year on year to $403.1 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $302.5 million underwhelmed, coming in 2.1% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.26 per share was 6.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
